issues.detail: The Greek 'τα μωρα' (the foolish ones) and 'τα ασθενη' (the weak ones) are plural nouns referring to people/entities, but the Vietnamese translation renders them as 'những sự dại' (the foolishness/foolish things) and 'những sự yếu' (the weakness/weak things), changing the subject from people to abstract qualities.
